title: Violet is Blue
start: Enter the portal to the Land of Snow on White Wolf Mountain (accessed from the Taverley side).

rewards.t: Lamp of joy – Grants 1,000 experience. (500 if an elite skill, e.g. Invention, is selected) (currently presents 1,000 experience in Invention)
Lamp of wonder – Grants 1,000 experience. (500 if an elite skill, e.g. Invention, is selected)
Lamp of laughter – Grants 1,000 experience. (500 if an elite skill, e.g. Invention, is selected)

steps.t: Talk to Violet found on the southern tip of White Wolf Mountain. [Chat: Accept]
Enter the Land of Snow portal.
Run north towards Violet and a cutscene will ensue.

Dodge snowballs and run up the hill. You can run straight up the far east side (or far west side) of the hill and avoid getting hit by any snowballs. If you cannot make it and get hit enough, eventually, it will ask if you want to make it easier.
p: The snowballs rolling down the hill

steps.t: Talk to Violet.
Knock on the door. [Chat: 3 Break the door down. › 1 To go on an adventure.]
p: The yeti parents, Betty and Trevor

steps.t: Talk to Trevor or Betty. [Chat: 1 YOU'VE CAPTURED A HUMAN GIRL! › 1 Yes!]
Talk to Violet in the room to the north.
Violet requests an object based on the starting letter five times. Search various objects around the room and bring her items that begin with the letter she requested.
Talk to Trevor or Betty.
Exit the building. [Chat: 1 Go on an adventure!]
Investigate the frozen bucket for an empty bucket.
p: The opening after going down the path

steps.t: Investigate a maple tree two times to receive maple logs.

sub.t: Investigate the logs to make a spile. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

steps.t: Use the spile on the maple tree.
Use the empty bucket on the same maple tree to receive a bucket of syrup.
Walk north, and check four leaning trees along the path.
Talk to Trevor to receive the firefly jar. [Chat: 1 Do you have anything useful?]

Shake multiple bushes and catch 10 fireflies. They may be difficult to see if playing on low graphics. To make this easier, right click the globe near your mini-map to toggle high contrast mode. This will make the fireflies stand out easier.
Talk to Violet.
Talk to Violet.
Take icy snow from behind Violet. [Chat: Any › Any › Any › Any › Any]
Click on the headless golems (spam clicking works) and put all 15 heads on.
Talk to Violet.
Collect 75 snowballs at the pile of snow to the south.
Continually search the abandoned crate for 3 carrots, 3 top hats, 21 coal.
Prune a tree to the west three times for 6 branches.
Build all melted snowmen (24 Construction XP), then talk to Violet after each snowman.
Walk north.
Reach into the icy water on the south-east shore to obtain a barrel.
p: Push Violet along the yellow path while following the blue path.

steps.t: Talk to Violet.
Navigate the ice maze while pushing Violet as shown in the diagram. You may move diagonally.

sub.t: The controls require precision, best to rotate your camera to give a birds eye view (top down) when trying to move diagonal. It may be helpful to think of a 3x3 square when moving diagonally, with the player character in the centre.

steps.t: Talk to Violet.
Investigate:

sub.t: The ice in the small pond to the north-east
The rotten barrel to the east of the sled (south-east of Violet)
The crate just to the west of the sled

steps.t: Chop down the Yeti village sign, a few steps south of the crate.
Investigate the open space, just east, multiple times while adding the items each time.
Talk to Violet. You can choose any name for the sled.
Quest complete!
